title: CAA Torrent Pipeline: decentralised archaeological data sharing proof of concept
description: Fixed software release associated with the CAA 2026 paper on decentralised archaeological data sharing using peer-to-peer and BitTorrent technologies. The Python workflow validates dataset metadata, packages datasets into verifiable archives, generates SHA-256 manifests, creates torrent files and magnet links, and records structured metadata for decentralised distribution. The original experimental dataset payloads are not stored in this software archive; the exact magnet URIs and infohashes used in the public experiment are preserved in MAGNETS.md.
